notes: Bowen Alley: printed 'Alley' and 'Bowen' between Court and 9th; between 9th and 8th the address labels read '801 St. Clair Alley' (west side) and '800 Bowen Alley' (east side); it lines up with St. Clair Alley on sheet 132 south of 8th (so 8th is a crossing). North of Court the same ~11 ft alley (unnamed) runs to the Parkway; treated as Bowen Alley. Width 16' printed at 8th. Coleman Alley (printed 'Alley' and 'Coleman', ~7 ft, no width printed) runs Court to 9th only. East Central Parkway printed with '(E.N. Canal)' for its north roadway; widths 155' (Walnut to the alley) and 145' (alley to Main) printed; points are at the centre of the full corridor (north block line ~456-488, south block line ~988-998). East Court Street 126' west of Main; east of Main it splits into 'N. Court' and 'S. Court' either side of a block (sheet 139 outline), so Main has three T's there. 'LAMAR' is printed in the north half of 9th St between Bowen and Coleman (no separate street drawn). Prior Alley and Lippincott enter Walnut only from the west (outlines of sheet 137). Walnut drifts east down the sheet (x 1362 at the Parkway to 1387 at 8th). North Court Street exists only in the sheet-139 outline east of Main on this sheet (old layout); on sheet 139 itself the 1919 court house covers it, so treat Main/North Court Street as superseded.
